# First Nano Banana run

Copy this into Cursor Agent after installing and configuring the plugin. No key is included.

> Use the nanobanana MCP tool nanobanana_generate_image for one image request. I checked the current Ace Data Cloud price and balance. Use model nano-banana-2-lite if this account offers it. Set resolution 1K, aspect_ratio 1:1, count 1. Set prompt to A teal ceramic cube on a plain cream background, studio product photograph, no text.. Submit at most once, keep the task ID, query it using nanobanana_get_task until terminal, and open the completed result. If pending, report the ID so I can resume without a second generation.
